notes.title: First Demo Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45576959/9c076ffd40b492d895072c432eed550a2e7683ba.png[/img]

Hello again, curious minds!
[u][b]I've been hard at work making some important improvements to the lab![/b][/u]

Here's what I've fine-tuned for you:

🔧 [b]Major Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Dimmed the lab lighting - Your eyes will thank you during those long research sessions!
[*] Fixed character display issues - Now all languages show their characters correctly
[*] Polished English text - Much smoother reading experience
[*] Completely refreshed Simplified Chinese - A thorough overhaul for better clarity
[/list]

Special thanks go to [b]L.C. and ⑨(ᗜˬᗜ)BAKA[/b] for their valuable feedback! Community input like yours helps make the lab a better place for everyone.

These updates should make your time in the laboratory much more comfortable. Keep exploring, and don't hesitate to share your thoughts—I'm always listening!

Happy researching~!
